Hi Amrit — thanks for the request and the form. We can take this on; below is the standard runflow we will execute and the customer-facing confirmation drafts we can send once complete. If you need an expedited path (same-day), indicate that and we can move to the expedited queue — subject to Dedicated capacity availability.

Operational runflow (high level):
1) Intake & validation (ticket created in Ops): confirm org_id, date ranges, and any excluded buckets. Expected ETA: 2 business hours.
2) Scope freeze: snapshot of current keys/objects affected and create an audit ticket.
3) Pre-check: ensure no active requests pinned to a retention hold. If holds exist we will notify you within 4 hours.
4) Execution (Ops team):
   - KV/cache sweep: remove in-memory prefix caches for the org_id across active nodes.
   - Prompt/output logs: delete entries from prompt-output store (logical delete + overwrite where required).
   - Request traces: remove internal trace logs and rotate/zeroize ephemeral artifacts.
   - Rotational evidence capture: generate proof bundle (operation logs, runbook job IDs, checksums).
   - Post-run verification: run a scan for residual keys; produce a verification report.
Estimated standard window: 48–72 hours from validated intake. Expedited: same business day (best-effort; requires priority ops slot).

Evidence & confirmation we will provide:
- Customer confirmation email (we will draft and send from your approved address).
- Evidence bundle: PDF (operations summary) + CSV checklist + job IDs (delivered via secure Drive link).
- Optional signed attestation (DocuSign) for legal teams.

Attachments: [attachment: deletion_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 92KB)], [attachment: confirmation_email_templates.docx (DOCX, 22KB)]

Next steps: please confirm the scope as listed in your form (SH-7721, 2026-01-01 -> 2029-05-10) and select Standard or Expedited. Once you confirm we will create a ticket and provide the ETA.
